token = None
for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if p['account_name']=='spotify':
        spotify_pw=p['password']
        break
else:
    raise Exception('No spotify password')
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
token = login_resp['access_token']
print('token_len', len(token))

query_title = 'Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes'
all_results=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.search_playlists(query=query_title, min_like_count=0, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None, access_token=token)
    if not page:
        break
    all_results.extend(page)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    page_index += 1
print('total_results', len(all_results))
# show candidates with exact title
exact=[r for r in all_results if r.get('title')==query_title]
print('exact_matches', len(exact))
for r in exact:
    print(r['playlist_id'], r['title'], r['owner']['email'], r['like_count'])
# also show best few titles
print('top_5_titles:', [(r['title'], r['playlist_id']) for r in all_results[:5]])

arguments.code:
token = apis.spotify.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=next(p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='spotify'))['access_token']
playlist_id=143
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=token)
songs = pl.get('songs',[])
print('playlist_songs', len(songs), [s['id'] for s in songs])
# get play_count for each song
song_details=[]
for s in songs:
    det = apis.spotify.show_song(s['id'])
    song_details.append({
        'id': det['song_id'],
        'title': det['title'],
        'artists': [a['name'] for a in det.get('artists',[])],
        'play_count': det.get('play_count')
    })
print('song_play_counts:')
for d in song_details:
    print(d['id'], d['title'], d['artists'], d['play_count'])
# select max
max_play = max(d['play_count'] for d in song_details)
max_songs=[d for d in song_details if d['play_count']==max_play]
print('max_play_count', max_play, 'num_tied', len(max_songs))
# tie-breaker deterministic: earliest in playlist order
playlist_order=[s['id'] for s in songs]
max_songs_sorted=sorted(max_songs, key=lambda d: playlist_order.index(d['id']))
selected=max_songs_sorted[0]
print('selected_song', selected)
# play it
resp = apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=token, song_id=selected['id'])
print('play_resp', resp)
